next.reason: 1985: "Within a declarative procedure, there must be no reference to any nondeclarative procedures."; 2023: "there shall be no reference to any nondeclarative procedures except in a RESUME statement.". Same prohibition, but 2023 adds an exception allowing a RESUME statement in a declarative to reference a nondeclarative procedure, a case the 1985 rule did not allow.
